header.name: telos
header.tagline: One workbench, and packets that recompute their own claims.

flows.title: How a claim about work becomes something a stranger can re-check
flows.alt: Eight stages from loose materials to a replayable packet: fixture, assemble, completeness, recompute, join, derive, witness, replay. The verdict folds out of the checks rather than being read off the packet, so a canned pass embedded in the materials can never win. A witness that reports drift lowers the derived verdict, and a witness that cannot be reached is recorded as coverage lost rather than counted as a pass. Three outcomes: match when every claim recomputed, drift when a recomputed value disagrees with its claim, and unverifiable when the evidence to check a claim is not there.
flows.footnote: A replay reads the packet. It does not re-run the work that produced it.

stages.title: Fixture
stages.note: Materials go in whole: sources, context, outputs, bytes.

stages.title: Assemble
stages.note: One canonical packet, with no clock inside the hash.

stages.title: Completeness
stages.note: A missing required field is named by its own path.

stages.title: Recompute
stages.note: Each output digest is redone from the bytes it carries.

stages.title: Join
stages.note: Every action is matched to the record that allowed it.

stages.title: Derive
stages.note: The verdict folds out of the checks, and is never read.

stages.title: Witness
stages.note: A second reader, whose absence is disclosed as absence.

stages.title: Replay
stages.note: Verify dispatches on the schema the packet declares.

returns.label: A WITNESS THAT REPORTS DRIFT LOWERS THE DERIVED VERDICT

outcomes.label: MATCH, EXIT 0
outcomes.note: every claim recomputed from the packet

outcomes.label: DRIFT, EXIT 1
outcomes.note: a recomputed value disagrees with its claim

outcomes.label: UNVERIFIABLE, EXIT 2
outcomes.note: the evidence to check a claim is not there
